title: Glasshouse and Radiators
author: Wren Yarrow
blurb: Marguerite Blackwood, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
